name: Boltaña (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a red cross set towards the hoist, charged at the crossing with the crowned municipal arms of Boltaña (a tower on white with the motto HAEC EST VICTORIA VESTRA).
history: Municipal flag of Boltaña; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Boltaña arms — tower on white, with motto
